verdict.rationale: The published pages describe the Unemployment Tax Registration (UTR) and Unemployment Tax Services (UTS) online flows as accessed with a user ID and password, and saved registrations resume later. No page documents a keyless, guest, or file-number entry path that lets a founder start the core flow without first creating an account.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
